body:
Part of #4023. Review finding of PR #4383 (the path kernel to `main`), review of 2026-11-27T18:06:55Z on head `7cd322966`, class B and the minor items. The fix is a sub-PR of `side/path-kernel`.

## What happens

The kernel and the converter recover silently from a rejected result in these places:

- `crates/pathkernel/src/region_build.rs:132-134`: a center that is not oriented is made canonical again; the refusal `NOT_ORIENTED` cannot be reached.
- `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/stage.rs:178-183`: the ABOVE branch makes an Air entry and drops the reason `ABOVE`.
- `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/exit.rs:54-64`: `Exit::new` accepts a retract below the material top; only `Exit::proved` checks it.
- `crates/motion/src/kernel_emit/pen.rs:140-149` and `:268-271`: a retract that is too small is clamped to the clearance height.
- `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/exit.rs:115-136`: a lead-out that does not fit is dropped with no note.
- `entry/material.rs:117,128`, `entry/air.rs:103,111,115`, `entry/hole.rs:26,28`, `entry/column.rs:37,40`, `load/trochoid.rs:188`: `.ok()` drops a construction failure.
- `crates/motion/src/kernel_emit/arcs.rs:58-60`: an empty arc output is reported as `ARC_NOT_MONOTONE`.

## The rule that closes the class

Never recover silently from a refused or rejected result. Refuse by name, or record the fallback with a note that names the failed check.

## Minor items of the same review

- About 51 files cite `docs/decisions/4024-path-kernel-design.md`. The file does not exist since the v0.27.0 cut: the record is in `RECOMMENDED.md` under the heading `#4024`, and `docs/decisions/4325-path-kernel-delivery.md` has the delivery plan.
- The record of #4024 lacks the facts that **No new dependency between our crates without a decision** asks for the two new edges (`camcraft-motion` to `camcraft-pathkernel`, `camcraft-pathkernel` to `camcraft-geometry`): the imported items, why the caller cannot pass the value in, what rebuilds.
- The notes of the review that are not blocking (the finite check before the division in `geo2d/medial.rs:101-102`; `geo()` drops the kind of a geometry error; the cached switch is read one time for each process; `WRITE_GOLDEN=1`; the fig8 2D Pocket readings test has no light twin).

## Done means

Each place of the list refuses by name or records its fallback, with a pin for each; the citations point to live files; a decision file has the dependency facts. Each item has its commit.
